$meta.source: Originally pulled from the user's Claude Design project "accelance design system" (claude.ai/design, project 019dd881-a2db-7d6c-921c-ac19b85cf9e3) via the DesignSync tool on 2026-07-27. RECONCILED 2026-08-10 to the Envoy brand actually shipped in packages/ui/src/assets/scss/_themes-vars.module.scss (rows 19+ of migration-checklist.md) — this is a newer, different Claude Design project (accelance-design-system-ee18bc52-ef81-4433-9e6b-233c9f4b825e) than the one this file originally came from.
$meta.note: Values below are the real, shipped Fluid brand tokens (renamed from Envoy 2026-08-26, same color values), read directly out of the app's own theme source — not a Claude Code guess. The prior 'accelance' blue (#0052CC) values this file used to hold are superseded; see DESIGN_SPEC.md Section 9 for the full reconciliation note. Do not add colors/sizes outside this file (CLAUDE.md hard rule 2).

openItems: Typeface: Inter Bold/Regular remains the current working body/UI font (confirmed unchanged in packages/ui/src/config.js) — the Envoy/Fluid rebrands did not touch this. The Logo component's wordmark specifically renders in 'Lexend' 300 Light (packages/ui/src/ui-component/extended/Logo.jsx, changed from 500 on 2026-08-27 alongside the new mark), a deliberate one-off brand-mark choice distinct from body typography, not yet added anywhere else. Serif alternatives (Cambria, Century Schoolbook) proposed pre-Envoy were never adopted.

Vector logo: RESOLVED 2026-08-27 — the mark is now the '1b — Branch' node-and-edge graph (see color.logo.mark above), implemented as inline SVG paths in Logo.jsx, the landing page's FluidLogo, AccelanceHeader.jsx, plus a static fluid-icon-tile.svg for favicons. There is no separate .ai/.eps master; treat the inline SVG in Logo.jsx as the current source of truth. This closes the letterform-mismatch gap flagged here after the 2026-08-26 Envoy→Fluid rename.
Primary blue value: RESOLVED by the Envoy rebrand — the app now uses #0F74BD (Azure Blue), not either previously-discussed candidate (#0052CC or #1A6FC4). Those values are historical only.

A dark theme (base #07111F, accent #4E7DFF) was proposed at some point but explicitly NOT adopted — no evidence backed it and it contradicts every confirmed light-themed source artifact. This tokens file intentionally has no dark-mode values. The current AI-Platform-Internal app (packages/ui) DOES have a working dark-mode toggle today (see DESIGN_SPEC.md Section 4 current-state) — whether the redesign keeps dark mode is an open question, logged in DESIGN_SPEC.md Section 9, since the brand system provides no dark palette to migrate to.

Secondary/positive Vivid Green (#13BA2F) exists in the shipped theme but multiple 2026-08 fixes (migration-checklist.md row 19 area, commits e79f382/cf247d8/4b2473b) had to revert it back to brand blue where it had leaked into primary UI chrome (canvas Save button, sidebar hover/active state) — treat green as a narrow secondary/positive accent only, never a primary-chrome substitute.

primary.usage: Primary buttons, headers, links, icons, primary actions (Fluid Azure Blue / azure-400)

primaryDark.usage: Hover/active states for primary elements; hero/logo gradient dark end (Fluid DeepBlue / deepblue-600)

secondaryAccent.usage: Fluid Vivid Green — secondary/positive brand accent ONLY (small UI accents, positive-status accents). Never use for primary buttons, nav, or canvas chrome — several 2026-08 fixes had to revert leaked green back to brand blue in exactly those spots (see openItems).

success.usage: Positive metrics, success states, agent-health (autonomous tier) — unchanged by the Envoy rebrand, distinct from secondaryAccent above

alert.usage: Business-value highlights, warnings. AA-compliant for large text only — never small body text on white.

compliance.usage: Compliance/risk indicators. AA-compliant for large text only — never small body text on white.

tint.usage: Card backgrounds, section tints, callout boxes, selected states (Fluid azure-100, primary-light)

gradientBrand.usage: Covers, hero sections, section dividers ONLY — not for general UI chrome (Fluid Azure Blue → DeepBlue)

autonomous.usage: Agent tier: fully autonomous, no human review needed

review.usage: Agent tier: human review required before/after execution

approval.usage: Agent tier: mandatory human approval before execution

agentStatus.note: This three-tier system is not optional styling — it ties directly to accelance's human-in-the-loop governance positioning. Every AI-proposed action must render as an explicit confirmation card (see components/agent/ApprovalCard); never silent auto-execution.

color.semanticRule: Colors are semantic, never decorative. Once a color is assigned a meaning (e.g. orange = business value), reuse it consistently — never reassign or cycle colors arbitrarily within the same product/document.

fontFamily.note: Inter is the current working default; Arial is the corporate fallback.

minimums.note: Never go smaller than these minimums.

radius.rule: Universal — applies to cards, buttons, inputs, images, modals. This is the one shape rule across every deliverable. No hard 0px-radius elements.

subtle.usage: Default when a shadow is needed at all — cards, dropdowns

shadow.rule: Flat/no-shadow is the default everywhere else. Use shadows sparingly, only to lift a card off a busy background.

motion.animations: Appear, with 0.2s stagger delay between items

iconography.library: Tabler Icons (outline style, 2px stroke, MIT license)
iconography.loadedVia: tokens/fonts.css webfont import, wrapped by the Icon component
iconography.style: Outline only — never filled, never mixed icon sets, no emoji/unicode-as-icon
iconography.housing: Monochrome, optionally housed in a colored circle or flat colored tile

motifs.hubAndSpoke: Radial/hub-and-spoke diagrams for 'components orbiting a central idea' content — usable anywhere
motifs.waveBanner: Curved/wave banner divider — RESERVED for one-pagers only, never in slide decks, never in app/website UI

logo.status: shipped — inline SVG, no separate vector master file
logo.mark: "1b — Branch" node-and-edge bubble graph (adopted 2026-08-27 from the "Fluid Logo" Claude Design exploration, project a8977b7a-1322-446b-9250-615d9b4fe305, file 'Fluid Logo.dc.html'): a deep-blue core (#062667) branching up-left to an azure node (#0F74BD) and up-right to a green node (#13BA2F), read as an agent dispatching to tools. Replaces the prior three-bar 'E' mark that no longer matched the 'Fluid' wordmark. Small sizes (packages/ui/src/ui-component/extended/Logo.jsx, packages/ui/src/views/landing/index.jsx, viewBox 0 0 200 200) use flat node colors; the favicon/tile treatment (packages/ui/src/assets/images/fluid-icon-tile.svg) uses the full radial-gradient version on a brand-gradient tile background. A companion exploration option ('1a — Horizontal molecule', three inline nodes, no branching) was reviewed and not chosen.
logo.wordmark: always lowercase "fluid", never capitalized — rendered in 'Lexend' 300 (Light; changed 2026-08-27, was 500 — not the app's Inter body font; logo-specific), color #062667 on light / #FFFFFF on dark
logo.variantProp: Logo.jsx exposes variant='auto'|'light'|'dark' so callers can force the white-on-gradient or navy-on-white treatment regardless of the app's dark-mode setting (used by the auth split-panel brand side)
logo.clearSpace: equal to the height of the lowercase "e" in the wordmark, on all sides
logo.never: stretch, rotate, recolor outside the brand palette, reduce opacity
